ValidationRule.description: SFM-12912: Acquisition Info field is required when selecting Acquired in fields: ‘Cancellation Subreason’ or ‘Secondary Cancellation Subreason’
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.skipValidation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Acquired") ), AND( ISCHANGED(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c, "Acquired") ) ), ISBLANK(Acquisition_Info__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot leave the Acquisition Info field blank
